rules.description: All preparatory tasks must be completed before the portal is made live to the general public for scholarship applications for a particular academic year.
rules.condition: When preparing to launch the portal for scholarship applications for a particular academic year.
rules.outcome: The portal cannot be made live until the identification of scholarship schemes, identification of stakeholders, registration of verifying authorities, creation of credentials for verifying authorities, and updation of metadata by institutes are completed.
rules.evidence_quote: different tasks that require to be completed before the Portal is made live to the general public for making scholarship applications for a particular AY.
